highlights.excerpt:
Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges.

They’re capable collaborators on ambitious projects in many fields, and show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
正式推出 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2，用来应对最棘手的技术挑战。

它们能在许多领域的高难度项目中担任得力协作者，并在编程、推理和视觉等方面有所提升。
highlights.name: Claude
highlights.text_zh: Claude 发布 Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2，编程、推理和视觉均有提升

highlights.excerpt:
During pre-release testing, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 worked on ambitious projects in many different fields. Here are a few.

From a one-paragraph prompt, Fable 5.2 designed three working electronic devices, including this home voice assistant hub.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
在预发布测试中，Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2 在许多不同领域完成了高难度项目。下面是其中几例。

仅凭一段提示，Fable 5.2 就设计出三款能工作的电子设备，包括这个家用语音助手中枢。
highlights.name: Claude
highlights.text_zh: Fable 5.2 仅凭一段提示就设计出三款能工作的电子设备

highlights.excerpt: We wanted to do more for the people who’ve been with us the longest. So with Fable 5.2, the longer you’ve been subscribed, the more Fable resets you get.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们想为陪伴最久的用户多做一些。所以在 Fable 5.2 上，订阅越久，获得的 Fable 重置次数就越多。
highlights.name: Boris Cherny
highlights.text_zh: Fable 5.2 按订阅时长发放更多 Fable 重置次数

highlights.excerpt:
It's never been this easy to build software

And never this hard to make money with it
highlights.excerpt_zh:
做软件从未如此容易

靠它赚钱却从未如此困难
highlights.name: @levelsio
highlights.text_zh: 做软件从未如此容易，靠它赚钱却从未如此困难

highlights.excerpt:
You can now connect multiple local computers to the same dot and choose which one it uses for a task.

It can build and test your app on a dedicated machine while you keep coding on your laptop.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
你现在可以把多台本地电脑连到同一个 dot，并选择用哪一台执行任务。

它可以在专用机器上构建和测试应用，同时你继续在笔记本电脑上写代码。
highlights.name: OpenAI Developers
highlights.text_zh: Codex 的 dot 可同时连接多台本地电脑并指定执行机器

highlights.excerpt:
Btw the new meta is:
- Fable 5.2 for planning
- Opus 5.5 for execution

Trust me, and thank me later.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
顺便说一下，新的最佳组合是：
- Fable 5.2 负责规划
- Opus 5.5 负责执行

相信我，回头再谢我。
highlights.name: Matt Shumer
highlights.text_zh: 新组合：Fable 5.2 负责规划，Opus 5.5 负责执行

highlights.excerpt:
Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.

Muse Ember can carry workflows across apps, call tools in sequence, run tests and make targeted code fixes. With a 1M-token context window
highlights.excerpt_zh:
今天我们推出 Muse Ember，这是我们最小、最高效的模型，专为复杂推理执行和日常智能体工作而打造。

Muse Ember 可以跨应用推进工作流、依次调用工具、跑测试并做针对性代码修复。它拥有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口
highlights.name: AI at Meta
highlights.text_zh: Meta 发布最小高效模型 Muse Ember，面向智能体日常工作
